title: Quantum Sphaera Companion: A Structure-First Mathematical Unfolding — full Companion and physics paper
description:
Quantum Sphaera Companion v5.1.0 is a minor version of the database-backed v5 release. As before, it comprises two complementary English documents from one source snapshot: the full Companion with its research history, and the physics paper Graded carriers and physical readouts: conditions for mass and geometric interpretation.

New in the full Companion are the research layers v4.10.0-r12 to r14 and the counterterm registry. The layers record status notes on inherited Koide and generation statements, a colour- and charge-neutral qubit under an assumed charge axis, the limits of a slot Fourier construction, a colour- and charge-preserving map between the sedenion and the Dixon carriers, and the reading of the charged-lepton phase as a bent octant with a flux-free guarded core. The counterterm registry records placeholders with guards that are inherited by every statement that uses them.

New in the physics paper: for three states with pairwise overlap one half the Koide value holds for every Bargmann phase, while the Gram determinant separates the flat octant, at which one mass vanishes, from three positive masses. A geometric reading of the required deficit as a flux-free core, including a short explanation of the borrowed term reflector, is given together with its status. The paper notes a conditional tau-mass value that rests on undetermined placeholders and is registered as a test against future data.

Scope: this is a conditional mathematical-physics research programme, not a completed unified theory. No native lepton spectrum, absolute physical mass scale, general gravitational field equations or closure of the open problems is established by this release. The Koide overlap, the core size and the counting rule per frame remain open. Database registration, hashes and provenance checks do not constitute proof of physical interpretation. The manuscript has undergone documented self-review, not independent peer review.

The package contains two English PDFs, compilable sources, a database snapshot and checksum manifests. Both document editions retain open argument-review obligations.

Version DOI: RESERVED. Concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19210728.
notes: Two complementary English documents in one versioned Companion record. The version DOI identifies the whole package. The German reader edition is excluded. Scientific guards and incomplete argument-review flags remain unchanged. Reservation and upload do not constitute publication.
